title: Hallie Bulkin  - Videos
description:
Your home for pediatric feeding, myofunctional therapy, airway-focused care, and clinician mentorship.

I’m Hallie Bulkin, MA CCC-SLP, CMT®, CPFT™. I train SLPs, OTs, PTs, and dental professionals to confidently assess and treat pediatric feeding & swallowing, oral function, tethered oral tissues, airway, and sleep-related breathing concerns.

🎙 Host of The Untethered Podcast (top 1.5% globally)
✨ New videos weekly

👉 Subscribe to elevate your skills, confidence, and impact.
